evidenceRule: Every result other than pass or n/a needs evidence: a file and field, plus a page or quote.

severity.S2: hides or misstates what the study can do, or breaks a surface

items.check: The paper is the right paper and version: DOI resolves to the same title; preprint and published versions are not confused
items.evidence: sources/SOURCE.json or program.json#source: the DOI and the two titles that disagree

items.check: The source files used are hashed and the hashes recorded (PDF, supplements, data)
items.evidence: the source file and the recorded vs computed sha256

items.check: License of PDF, materials, data and author code is recorded, or recorded as unknown
items.evidence: the file (sources/SOURCE.json, package/*/human/key.json) and the field that lacks a license entry

items.check: All supplements, appendices and OSF materials the paper points to were looked for, and the result is recorded (found / not public / not found)
items.evidence: each pointer in the paper (page + quote) and the search result recorded for it

items.check: Scanned or image-only pages were OCR'd or read as images, not skipped
items.evidence: the PDF pages without a text layer and the program evidence that cites them

items.check: Every study in the paper is found, including pilots and studies reported only in the supplement
items.evidence: the study in the paper (page + quote) that program.json#studies lacks

items.check: Every `verbatim` field appears word for word in the source at the cited page
items.evidence: program.json#node:<id>.<field> and the cited page where the value is not found
items.notes: Quote check (`check_quotes.py`) No verbatim fields is a concern, not evidence that all wording was captured.

items.check: Nothing paraphrased is labelled `verbatim`; nothing quoted is labelled `derived`
items.evidence: program.json#node:<id>.<field>, its origin, and the page + quote that shows the right label

items.check: Gaps are labelled `missing`, never filled with plausible text. The auditor picks the 5 fields most likely to be guessed (exact wording, response scales, counterbalancing, stimuli lists) and checks each against the source
items.evidence: program.json#node:<id>.<field>, the value, and the page showing the paper does not state it

items.check: Sample sizes (recruited, excluded, analysed), conditions and assignment match the paper
items.how: auto (where Bench GT exists) + agent → EVAL 1
items.evidence: program.json#node:<participants>.<field> and the page + quote with the paper's number

items.check: Reported statistics are exact: numbers, signs, inequality direction (p < .001 vs p > .001), df
items.evidence: effects.json#effect:<id>.reported or program.json#node:<result>.<field>, and the page + quote

items.check: Each open issue is real (the paper does not state it) and specific; no filler issues
items.evidence: program.json#issue:<id> and the page + quote where the paper states it, or why it is filler

items.check: Evidence pages are right: a sample of 10 quotes is found on the cited page
items.evidence: program.json#evidence:<id>, its cited page, and where the quote was (or was not) found

items.check: Every study and condition in the paper appears in the program, or is listed as excluded with a reason
items.evidence: the study or condition in the paper (page + quote) missing from program.json

items.check: Commercial or copyrighted instruments are marked location-only; their items are not included
items.evidence: program.json#node:<id>.<field> holding instrument items, and the instrument's name

items.check: **Participant independence:** each AI participant answers in a fresh context, with no access to study files, hypotheses or other participants' answers
items.evidence: package/<slug>/task/adapter.py and the prompt index that carries another participant's reply
items.notes: Incident I-02 A probe cannot establish independence when replies are parsed or its transcript is forgeable; treat as a concern requiring review.

items.check: Sequential visibility: a participant sees each screen only when the original participants did; nothing later leaks into an earlier prompt
items.evidence: the step or prompt that shows a later screen too early (materials.json or adapter prompt), and the paper page

items.check: Prompts contain no hypothesis, condition names or study labels that the original participants did not see
items.evidence: the prompt index and the word that reveals a hypothesis, condition name or study label

items.check: Every original human subject role is an agent participant; scripted partners are used only where the paper used them, and are labelled
items.evidence: task/task.json#agents or scriptedRoles and the paper page describing the role

items.check: Conditions are assigned as in the paper (random, counterbalanced, blocked); counts per arm are balanced as designed
items.evidence: task/task.json#arms and the per-arm session counts from a stub run

items.check: Replies are parsed into the paper's response format; unparseable replies are counted and reported, never dropped silently
items.evidence: the session fields after unparseable replies (dropped, or mapped to a value)

items.check: Studies that cannot run (missing materials, unsupported modality) refuse to run; nothing is substituted
items.evidence: capabilities.json#run, study.json#readiness, the blocking issue ids and the stub-run outcome
items.notes: Burton 2022, Kreis 2025 A stub transcript is untrusted when package code shares its interpreter; refusal needs independent verification.

items.check: Profiles, if used, are recorded per session and the run is labelled as a deviation
items.evidence: capabilities.json#profiles and the session fields
items.notes: Desktop #45 Profile use must be recorded for every session and explicitly identified as a deviation; field presence alone is insufficient.

items.check: The analysis reproduces the paper's reported statistics from the original human data, within the stated tolerance
items.evidence: artifacts/replay/replay-compare.json#humanMatchesPaper and the effects that did not match

items.check: Exclusion rules are applied as in the paper, and the counts match
items.evidence: artifacts/replay/human-check.json#exclusions and the paper page with the exclusion rule and counts
items.notes: An exclusions statement alone does not verify the rule or counts against the paper.

items.check: Effect definitions and directions match the paper (which group minus which)
items.evidence: effects.json#effect:<id>.contrast (treatment/reference) and the page + quote with the paper's direction

items.check: Author code is never edited to make numbers match; differences are reported
items.evidence: the author-code file and the diff against the published code

items.check: The parts of the design missing from the human data are listed (`notMapped`) and not compared
items.evidence: artifacts/replay/human-check.json#notMapped vs capabilities.json#humanData.missing

items.check: Human data are not in any repository; the key (source, version, hash, license) is recorded
items.evidence: the data file path inside the study folder, or package/<slug>/human/key.json and the missing key field

items.check: AI vs human comparisons report n, the uncertainty and the direction match, not only a pass/fail
items.evidence: artifacts/replay/replay-compare.json#effects[] and the missing n, uncertainty or direction field

items.check: Export self-test passes (files and hashes, every study renders, scripts run, MCP tools respond, replay smoke test)
items.evidence: the self-test step that failed and its message

items.check: No local paths, user names, keys or private project files in any export or published file
items.evidence: the file and line holding the path, user name or key (never the key itself)
items.notes: Checked by hand for the first 12 skills

items.check: No duplicated content inside a published revision
items.evidence: the duplicated files (paths and sha256)

items.check: Tools refuse what `capabilities` declares impossible; no substitute output
items.evidence: the capability that says no and the call that returned output instead of a refusal
items.notes: Desktop #45 An untrusted stub transcript cannot prove tools refused impossible operations; errors are concerns.

items.check: Install lines in README work on macOS and Windows (`python3` vs `py`)
items.evidence: the README line and the platform where it fails

items.check: The skill answers 5 standard questions correctly from the files alone: what was the design, what did a participant see in condition X, what was the main result, what is missing, can it run
items.evidence: the question, the skill's answer and the paper page with the right answer

items.check: Catalog entry has title, authors, year, DOI and a description
items.evidence: the catalog source (program.json#source, SOURCE.json, paper_metadata.json) and the empty field

items.check: One paper, one entry: no duplicates across DOI, preprint DOI and title keys
items.evidence: the entries that share a DOI or title key

items.check: Published files follow the sources policy: no PDFs, `sources/` or human data unless the license allows
items.evidence: the published path that the sources policy excludes

items.check: Capabilities are honest: `traceable` only after a human line check, `replayable` only with a passing replay
items.evidence: capabilities.json#<capability> and the check result that contradicts it

items.check: Revision manifest hashes match the files; the previous revision is kept
items.evidence: the revision manifest entry and the file whose hash differs

items.check: The website database, the GitHub snapshot and the desktop library show the same revision after a sync (allow for the 30 s search cache)
items.evidence: the three revisions seen (website, snapshot, desktop)

items.check: A paper with missing optional fields (no authors, no resources) still renders on web and desktop
items.evidence: the catalog entry and the surface that failed to render

items.check: The library lists only extracted studies; not-yet-extracted papers are in their own view
items.evidence: the library entry without extracted content

items.check: Opening a study gives a project with content (program, materials, artifacts); never an empty project
items.evidence: the study that opened empty

items.check: Library and study pages refresh after a publish without restarting the app
items.evidence: the steps to reproduce the stale view

items.check: Each study shows what it can and cannot do, in words a researcher understands
items.evidence: the study page and the statement a researcher could not understand

items.check: "Done" is checked against files, not against the model going idle; a schema pass is not taken as completeness
items.evidence: the check that failed (check_program --complete, effects check, capabilities --check) and its message

items.check: Request size stays under the gateway limits; failures name the cause (size vs context)
items.evidence: the request, its size and the error returned

items.check: Cost per study is recorded; batch runs stop before the hosted quota is exhausted
items.evidence: the run log without a cost record, or the batch that ran past the quota

items.check: Release: version bumped after all intended PRs are merged and not drafts; tag only on the merged commit; all 15 release files present; Mac app notarized; update feeds show the new version
items.evidence: the release step that failed

items.check: No secrets in logs, issues, PRs or published files
items.evidence: the file and line (never the secret itself)
